title: PA, Speaker & DJ Equipment Hire Melbourne | Sonido
description: Speaker, PA and DJ equipment hire in Melbourne. Priced by crowd size for a 24 hour hire, collection or delivery.
introCopy: Audio and DJ equipment for events across Melbourne. Every package is priced for a 24 hour hire and includes stands and cabling.
packagesNote: 24 hour hire. Collection from us, delivery available.

packages.heading: Compact PA
items: Connects to a phone or laptop
packages.note: Private functions, small bars, outdoor gatherings.

packages.heading: Full-range PA
items: Additional headroom for a full room
packages.note: Venues, function rooms, larger private events.

packages.heading: DJ setup
packages.note: Stock rotates between the RX2, RX3 and XZ. Specific models can be requested, subject to availability.

packages.heading: Complete system
packages.note: Warehouses, large venues and events built around a dancefloor.

elseCopy: Subwoofers on their own, additional speakers, lighting, or a configuration that isn't listed here. Tell us what your event requires.

terms.heading: Hire period
terms.copy: All prices are for a 24 hour hire. Longer periods are available on request.

terms.heading: Collection and delivery
terms.copy: Collection from us as standard. Delivery is available depending on location and is quoted at the time of enquiry.

terms.heading: Bond
terms.copy: A bond equal to the hire price, refunded once the equipment is returned undamaged. Photo ID is taken at collection and deleted on return.

terms.heading: Availability
terms.copy: Stock rotates, so prices are shown from. The exact unit is confirmed at the time of booking.
